TaskDescription: [motor execution] Standardized right-arm reaching to one of three illuminated targets (three movement types), performed under three assistance levels (free, low, high).
Instructions: Seated participant reached a target when a light turned on with the right arm, at a normal pace, then returned to resting position with the hand on the right leg.
Description: NeBULA: high-density EEG and surface EMG recorded during a standardized upper-limb reaching task under three robotic assistance levels, for neuromechanical biomarker research.
